# Termux-LlamaCpp Full Technical Specification (v1.2.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Production-Grade GGUF LLM Runtime Utilizing Device Resources, Model Manager & OpenAI Server for Android ARM64
Ships verified Android ARM64 native binaries with bundled shared libraries and device resource optimization, enabling instant zero-compilation local inference and a robust OpenAI-compatible REST/SSE server.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-llamacpp
- Command: pip install termux-llamacpp && termux-llama install
# or Node.js:
npm install -g termux-llamacpp && termux-llama install
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-llamacpp
